name: Impromptu Networking
deliverable: Three rapid rounds of paired micro-interviews establishing shared context

steps.text: Ask two questions: the challenge you bring and the asset you offer this group.
Pair outside your team; chime at two minutes.
Re-answer both questions with a new partner.
Run round three with one more partner.

failure: One partner talks through most of the round, so the other gets a rushed answer and the room learns half its assets.
intervention: Stop on the chime and model the handoff: if you are mid-sentence, stop; your partner's time starts now.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
